description: Source code for the search layer of the channels store in Mattermost, implementing indexing, updating, and autocompletion functionalities for channels.

classes.name: SearchChannelStore
classes.description: A store that manages search indexing and retrieval for channels, including creation, updates, deletions, and autocompletion.

methods.name: deleteChannelIndex
methods.description: Deletes a channel from the search index if it is an open channel.

methods.name: indexChannel
methods.description: Indexes a channel and its members in the search engine.

methods.name: bulkIndexChannels
methods.description: Performs bulk indexing of multiple channels.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new channel and indexes it.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a channel and reindexes it, including reindexing posts if channel type changes.

methods.name: reindexChannelPosts
methods.description: Reindexes posts associated with a channel when its type changes.

methods.name: UpdateMember
methods.description: Updates a channel member and reindexes user and channel data.

methods.name: SaveMember
methods.description: Saves a new channel member and indexes user and channel data.

methods.name: RemoveMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a channel and updates indexes.

methods.name: RemoveMembers
methods.description: Removes multiple members from a channel and updates indexes.

methods.name: CreateDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel between two users and indexes it.

methods.name: SaveDirectChannel
methods.description: Saves a direct message channel and indexes it.

methods.name: Autocomplete
methods.description: Provides channel autocompletion for a user, using search engine or fallback to database.

methods.name: AutocompleteInTeam
methods.description: Provides channel autocompletion within a team, using search engine or fallback.

methods.name: searchAutocompleteChannels
methods.description: Searches channels via search engine for autocompletion.

methods.name: searchAutocompleteChannelsAllTeams
methods.description: Searches channels across all teams via search engine for autocompletion.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteMembersByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all channel memberships for a user and updates indexes.

methods.name: RemoveAllDeactivatedMembers
methods.description: Removes deactivated members from a channel and updates user indexes.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteMembersByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes all members of a channel and updates user indexes.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes a channel and removes it from the search index.
